_notes: Target page for withdraw_notify: /withdraw/transaction — leave tab 「รายการที่อนุมัติแล้ว」 open (money ready to transfer).
Do NOT use 「รายการรออนุมัติ」 for withdraw_notify — that tab is gameplay/log review only.
Approved-tab auto refresh clicks 「ค้นหา」 (keeps filters). Do NOT tick the site's 「โหลดอัตโนมัติทุก 3 นาที」 — use ClipSync page refresh instead.
Close-job form is below the fold in the withdrawal modal — scroll_into_view first.
After บันทึก, the site shows BootstrapVue confirm (ยืนยันการถอนรายการ) — click ตกลง, then SweetAlert2 success — click ตกลง again.

One dismiss_dialog closes ONE popup: the success SweetAlert2 that mounts from the confirm click is left for the wait_for/verify_result steps, which also pass on satisfied_by success_observed when it is already gone.

row_approved_indicators is the post-submit proof on the list page (row shows อนุมัติ). Keep it OUT of already_confirmed_indicators — findConfirmButton would then skip rows whose action button is literally 'อนุมัติ'.

Shop payout account is matched by the slip 'จาก' (sender) account. Prefer the position-aware mask template (sender_account_masked, e.g. '5840xxx518') which works across banks that hide the tail (KBANK 'xxx-x-x0758-x') or show few digits (BBL '584-0-xxx518'); sender_account_last4 is a fallback.
Keep dry_run true until live clicks are verified end-to-end.
